metaDescription: Order custom 2 oz dispensary containers in bulk. Perfect for samples, lip balms, and small items. Get your quote today!
introHtml: Custom 2 oz dispensary containers are ideal for packaging small product samples, lip balms, salves, or other personal care items. The compact size makes them easy to distribute at trade shows or include in welcome kits. Choose from plastic or glass options and add your logo with screen printing or labels. These containers offer a practical way to introduce customers to your brand without committing to full-size packaging.
